_comment: Reminders bot (docs/reminders.md). The numbers and the wording are the clinic's to set; the bot only fills the {placeholders}. Nothing here charges a card: after the deadline the check is listed for a person to decide.
subject: Action needed: Blue Shield check for your {clinic} visit
body: Blue Shield of California paid the claim for your {clinic} visit{dos_phrase} by mailing a check to you instead of to us.
This payment belongs to {clinic} for the services you received. Please do one of the following by {deadline}:
1. Bring or mail the check to our office, signed on the back with "Pay to the order of {clinic}", or
2. If you already deposited it, pay the same amount to {clinic}.
If we have not received the check or the payment by {deadline}, the card we have on file for you will be charged ${amount}, as described in the financial policy you signed.
If you have not received the check, or you believe this message is a mistake, please reply to this e-mail{phone_phrase} so we can help.
final_subject: Final notice: Blue Shield check for your {clinic} visit
cashed_subject: Action needed: Blue Shield payment for your {clinic} visit
cashed_body: Blue Shield of California paid the claim for your {clinic} visit{dos_phrase} by mailing a check to you instead of to us, and Blue Shield shows that the check has been cashed.
This payment belongs to {clinic} for the services you received. Please pay ${amount} to {clinic} by {deadline}.
If we have not received the payment by {deadline}, the card we have on file for you will be charged ${amount}, as described in the financial policy you signed.
If you believe this message is a mistake, please reply to this e-mail{phone_phrase} so we can help.
